name: kpi-tile
title: KPI tile
description: A single figure with a micro label and an optional change indicator. Tiles sit in a row inside a summary card.
whenToUse: Headline numbers (volume, uplift, budget). Put several in a tx-kpi-row. Tiles inside a summary card are the one allowed exception to 'no box in a box'.

variants.description: Gold top edge, for the one figure that matters most.

a11y: Say the direction in words too (for example '+4.2% vs last year'), not only with colour or an arrow.
